Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1997
RESOLUTION TRUST CORPORATION OF
PAKISTAN ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to make provision for
realization of the non performing loans and other assets of various banks and
development financial institution.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 15th February, 1997]
No.F2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 14‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas, it is expedient to make
provision for realization of the non -performing loans and other financial
assets of various banks and development financial institutions owned or
controlled by the Federal Government.
And whereas, the National Assembly
is not in Session and the President s satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (I) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President s pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:-‑
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Resolution Trust Corporation of Pakistan
Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall apply to the whole of
Pakistan
(3) It shall come into force at once

direction and superintendence of the Corporation shall vest in the Board which

sections.shortTitle: Resolution Trust Corporation of Pakistan Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Transfer of non-performing assets

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1997
RESOLUTION TRUST CORPORATION OF
PAKISTAN ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to make provision for
realization of the non performing loans and other assets of various banks and
development financial institution.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 15th February, 1997]
No.F2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 14‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas, it is expedient to make
provision for realization of the non -performing loans and other financial
assets of various banks and development financial institutions owned or
controlled by the Federal Government.
And whereas, the National Assembly
is not in Session and the President s satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (I) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President s pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:-‑
13. Transfer of non‑performing
assets.‑‑(1)
The Corporation may, at any time before the first anniversary date issue to a
financial institution a letter for the transfer to the Corporation of the non‑performing
assets that are on the books of the financial institution as of a date
specified in such letter.
(2) On issuance of the letter under
subsection (1), all right, title and interest of such financial institution in
all non‑performing assets held on its books as of the date specified in
such letter shall, with immediate effect, and without the necessity of any
further action or instrument, be deemed transferred, assigned, sold and
conveyed by the financial institution to the Corporation.
(3) The Corporation shall specify
the terms and conditions for the transfer of the non‑performing assets to
each financial institution to which a letter is issued under subsection (1).
Such terms and conditions shall specify the basis for identifying and
calculating the outstanding amount of the non performing assets and adjustments
thereof which shall include the reversal of any suspended interest or mark jip,
penal interest, provision for doubtful loans, and any other adjustment that the
Corporation may decide, and the basis of determining the amount of any bond
issued or of determining net proceeds under section 156, audit procedures, on
going obligations of the Financial Institution and such other matters as the
Corporation may deem appropriate.
(4) The Corporation shall have the
right to review all non‑performing assets transferred to it and to
classify all or any such non‑performing assets as non‑complying
assets in accordance with the terms and conditions provided to the financial
institution pursuant to subsection (3) and all right, title and interest of the
Corporation in all non‑performing assets classified by the Corporation as
non‑complying assets shall be deemed to be transferred, assigned, sold
and conveyed back by the Corporation to such financial institution.
(5) Notwithstanding the transfer,
assignment, sale or conveyance effected by the provisions of subsection (2),
the financial institution concerned shall continue to prosecute or defend all
pending legal proceedings and on application made by the Corporation to the
appropriate Court of law, the Corporation shall be immediately substituted in
place of the financial institution concerned with all rights and privileges of
the prosecuting financial institution.

Part I, 15th February, 1997]
No.F2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 14‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas, it is expedient to make
provision for realization of the non -performing loans and other financial
assets of various banks and development financial institutions owned or
controlled by the Federal Government.
And whereas, the National Assembly
is not in Session and the President s satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (I) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President s pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:-‑
14. Consideration for transfer of
non‑performing assets.‑‑(1) After the transfer to the Corporation of any non‑performing
assets under section 13 the Corporation shall determine the outstanding amount
of the non‑performing assets as of the date of transfer.
(2) In the event that the
privatization of the financial institution is affected prior to the third
anniversary date, the Corporation shall issue a bond to the financial
institution, at the time of such privatization. Such bond shall have an
aggregate principal amount equal to the amount calculated for this purpose in
accordance with subsection (3) of section 13 and shall bear return or profit at
a rate and have a repayment schedule to be determined by the Corporation.
(3) In the event that privatization
of a financial institution is not effected on or prior to the third anniversary
date, the Corporation shall pay to the financial institution on the second
anniversary date an amount equal to the net proceeds realized from the non‑performing
assets till such second anniversary date and make quarterly payments thereafter
equal to any net proceeds realized from the non‑performing assets during
the preceding quarter.
Explanation.‑‑For purposes of
subsection (3) "net proceeds" with respect to any non‑performing
assets means the proceeds realized by the Corporation from any sale, lease or
other disposition or financing of such non -performing assets less recovery
fees to be retained by the Corporation, or as determined by the Corporation in
accordance with terms and conditions to be provided by the Corporation to the
concerned financial institution under subsection (3) of section 13.
